title_zh: 选定海湾内停泊的游船路线

scenario.label_zh: 确定海湾停泊的游船路线
scenario.goal_zh: 确认短程游船的停泊地点，并选择留在海湾内的路线

context_zh: 游客在出发前向游船船长询问两条当日可选路线。
author: author-phase10-a

sentences.speaker: Imani
sentences.text: Does the short boat trip leave the bay?

sentences.speaker: Captain Ellis
sentences.text: No. We stay inside it and stop near the sheltered eastern shore.

sentences.speaker: Imani
sentences.text: Will we keep moving while we have lunch?

sentences.speaker: Captain Ellis
sentences.text: We'll drop the anchor at the lunch stop, if conditions remain suitable. I'll make that decision on the water.

sentences.speaker: Imani
sentences.text: Then I'll choose the short route. I don't want the trip out along the coast.

sentences.speaker: Captain Ellis
sentences.text: The bay route it is. Please join the safety briefing before we board.
